evaluation-system.goal: Keep independent session and project-app evaluation current, evidence-backed, and useful to responsible owners and humans.
acceptance: Eligible completed sessions receive a durable evaluation or an explicit structured skip.
Watched project apps receive current independent reviews when their meaningful state changes or the baseline review is due.
Findings reach the responsible owner, and human notification is limited to a concrete useful action or decision.
Evaluation pipeline defects are represented by bounded repair work or exact Conditions rather than monitoring prose.

session-audit.goal: Keep eligible completed May-agent sessions evaluated with trustworthy criteria and traceable evidence.
acceptance: Every eligible terminal session is covered by direct aftermath or the bounded backfill reconciler.
Each evaluation is linked to its source session and records a verdict, structured skip, or visible review-process failure.
Criteria and drift work use concrete samples and produce bounded calibration or criteria changes.

project-app-audit.goal: Keep an independent, evidence-backed health assessment for every watched project app.
acceptance: Each watched target has one standing audit task with a current meaningful-state fingerprint.
Material changes produce a durable report containing raw facts, evaluator judgment, and concrete verification.
Target findings are routed to the target owner without transferring target remediation into evaluation.app.

finding-delivery.goal: Keep owner feedback and human notification accurate, deduplicated, and tied to observable findings.
acceptance: A new or materially changed actionable finding is delivered to the responsible project owner with artifact and verification context.
Unchanged findings do not create duplicate owner work or human messages.
Human messages describe the situation and exact decision needed; delivery alone is never recorded as issue resolution.

evaluator-reliability.goal: Keep evaluation.app's own reconciliation, workflows, evidence, and reporting reliable and bounded.
acceptance: Known recurring responsibilities reconcile through explicit workflows and unfamiliar exceptions reach the evaluator owner.
Workflow and review failures stay visible and become bounded evaluator-local repair work when action is required.
External waits use exact Conditions, and repeated observations do not create duplicate repair tasks.

pipeline-health.goal: Keep evaluation pipeline coverage, throughput, review delivery, and anomaly state observable and within policy.
acceptance: The standing pipeline monitor records a current snapshot and wakes the owner only when anomaly state changes.
Missed eligible sessions are recovered by the standing bounded backfill task.
A persistent pipeline anomaly becomes one bounded repair task or exact Condition with an observable recovery check.

criteria-and-calibration.goal: Keep session-evaluation criteria versioned and calibrated against concrete human or independent review samples.
acceptance: Calibration work names a concrete sample cohort and disagreement being tested.
Accepted changes update criteria, scoring guidance, and regression evidence together.
A completed calibration batch is absorbed into criteria state and leaves the live task graph.

drift-detection.goal: Detect meaningful session-quality drift only when comparable agent cohorts and evaluation evidence exist.
acceptance: A drift judgment identifies the compared cohorts, time windows, criteria version, and supporting samples.
Aggregate movement without a comparable cohort remains an observation and does not create speculative repair work.
Confirmed drift creates one bounded calibration, criteria, workflow, or owner-feedback task with a verification condition.

system-integrity.goal: Keep evaluation.app's task ownership, event routing, reports, and runtime state internally consistent.
acceptance: Each concrete evaluator-local integrity defect is represented by one bounded repair task with an observable postcondition.
External prerequisites are represented by exact Conditions with an owner, observer, next check, and fallback.
Resolved repairs leave no duplicate writer, stale compatibility path, or permanent incident task in the seed tree.
